term: first presence at a supplied time under the chosen temporal order
definition: BeginsAt h w x t requires IsAt w x t and absence of x at every s strictly earlier than t in the supplied Mathlib Preorder. It asserts neither later persistence nor modal contingency, nor a cause of the beginning. Arbitrary preorders need not compare all times; the control uses Int standard linear order and t=0. All earlier integer times are absent and all nonnegative times present by that control assignment.
note: World-relative temporal onset, not birth/rebirth between modal worlds or a new interpretation of the primitive beginsContingency in PossibleCauseOfContingency. Existing ChangeDoesNotGiveModalContingency separates world/time variation but is not falsely reused as a theorem about this onset control.
